about_the_game:
The office is under siege by a horde of relentless zombies! Can you survive and protect your coworkers? Arm yourself, rally your colleagues, and strategize to eliminate the undead menace. It's up to you to save the day and restore order amidst the chaos. Will you rise to the challenge and become the hero your office needs?

Fight through waves of zombies

Battle relentless zombie hordes and save uninfected workers by leading them to safety

Recruit Coworkers to the Cause

Assemble a team of elite coworkers from four classes—Soldier, Medic, Engineer, and Athlete—to defend your workplace.

Level Up and Purchase Powerful Weapons

Enhance your skills and those of your recruits, and uncover powerful weapons to face increasing waves of enemies.

Demo Version

The demo version of this game excludes the following features that will be available in the release version of the full game:

  • Save/Load System

  • Extended level selection

  • Extended character selection

  • Extended mode selection

  • Extended wave/round objectives

  • Extended mission objectives

The demo version of this game includes the following features that will not be available in the full game:

  • Demo modes

content_descriptors.notes: Contain content not suitable for all audiences, including violence
